Hero_Desc_Chopi:
A young werebeast who just started her training.
The people she views as role models have a few screws loose, but it doesn't seem like she's caught on.
Such childish innocence. Perhaps such unassuming natures create heroes?
Album_Like_Chopi: Werebeasts who are stronger than her.
Album_Chopi1: Chopi searches for a mentor to become stronger. However, there aren't many werebeasts in the village qualified to teach her, making her quest difficult.
Album_Chopi2: In truth, Chopi is already quite strong, but she doesn't realize it. She often fails to notice when her chosen mentors are actually weaker than her.
Album_Chopi3: Due to a lack of systematic training, Chopi isn't very good at fighting despite her strength and stamina. Combined with her personality, this often prevents her from performing well in battle.
Album_Chopi4: Chopi greatly admires Tig, portraying even her most mundane actions as steps toward making history. Those around her worry that she's chosen the wrong werebeast to look up to.
Album_Chopi5: Chopi once attempts to see how strong she is by wildly chopping down trees in the wilderness.  Upon seeing the wreckage, Diana scolds Chopi harshly and tells her to use only trees that have already been cut down.
Album_Chopi6: She tries learning from other races who enjoy training, but their intense methods don't match her preference for more enjoyable workouts.
Album_Chopi7: Chopi keeps trying to rope me into her idea of fun training. But with how extreme her standards are, just walking alongside her is enough to leave me completely wiped out. And yet, even as I lie there catching my breath, Chopi still looks for meaning in it all—it's kind of amazing, really.
LoveHeroCancel_Chopi: It was a great training session!
Food_ChefNote_Chopi_Hate1: She said the unsettling wobbling shape makes her feel on edge.
Food_ChefNote_Chopi_Hate2: She looked puzzled, wondering aloud why this dish has to be so overly complicated.
Food_ChefNote_Chopi_Like1: Chopi claims a real hero should vigorously grab and tear into this dish with their hands.
Food_ChefNote_Chopi_Like2: Looking around to see if there were any other werebeasts were nearby, she discreetly eats the dish while pretending not to care.
Food_ChefNote_Chopi_Like3: She innocently asks if eating a lot of this would turn her into a great hero, finishing the entire dish in no time.
Food_ChefNote_Chopi_Like4: She got excited, saying it resembled the trees in Werebeast Forest where she lives.
Food_ChefNote_Chopi_Like5: She loved it, saying it tasted like the candy she ate when she was even younger than she is now.
Food_ChefNote_Chopi_Like6: Saying it was fun to guess the ingredients in it, she chews each piece slowly.
Food_ChefNote_Chopi_Like7: She commented it was a little sweet, but she ate all of them, fixated on the nutty almond flavor.
Food_ChefNote_Chopi_Like8: She had a hard time eating the food because it is in powdered form. After she finished eating it, she carefully licked all the remaining powder off her hands.
Food_ChefNote_Chopi_Like9: She ate with gusto, aspiring to one day become a hero to the werebeasts and having her face become their symbol.

Hello, Master! It is Chopi!!
This morning, Village Chief Diana was moving something heavy, so I helped her!
Then I practiced swinging my axe just as Teacher Mynx instructed! I swung it 283 times! That is a lot, right?
Hm? Why am I telling you all this?
I decided to report everything I do on my path toward becoming a great hero to you every day!
I did something good, so you will praise me, right? Then I will feel energized and work even harder!
So please hurry and praise me! Pleeease?
...Hehehe! Thank you, Master! If you praise me, I can do things like this as many times as it takes!
Then tomorrow, I will walk the hero's path diligently and report to you again!! Goodbye!!
